text: Of David, in his changing his behavior before Abimelech, and he drove him off, and he went. 1 I will bless YHWH at every time; His praise [is] continually in my mouth.
In YHWH my soul boasts; let the humble hear and be glad.
Magnify YHWH with me, and let us exalt His name together.
I sought YHWH, and He answered me, and He snatched me up from all my fears.
They looked toward Him, and they shone, and their faces were not ashamed.
This poor one called out, and YHWH heard, and from all his troubles He saved him.
The angel of YHWH encamps all around those who fear Him, and he rescues them.
Taste and see that YHWH [is] good; blessed [is] the man [who] takes refuge in Him.
Fear YHWH, His holy ones, for There is no lack for those fearing Him.
The young lions are in want and are hungry, and those seeking YHWH shall not lack any good [thing].
Come, [my] sons, listen to me; the fear of YHWH I will teach you⁺.
Who [is] the man desiring life, loving days, that he may see good?
Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of YHWH [are] toward the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
The face of YHWH [is] against those doing evil, to cut off from the earth their memory.
They cry out, and YHWH hears, and He delivers them from all their troubles.
Near [is] YHWH to the broken of heart, and He saves those crushed in spirit.
Many [are] [are] the afflictions of a righteous one, but from them all YHWH delivers him.
He guards all his bones; not one of them is broken.
Evil will kill the wicked, and those hating a righteous one will be held guilty.
YHWH redeems the soul of His servants, and not any of those taking refuge in Him will be condemned.
